data_objects.name: loan_applications
data_objects.meaning: Loan application records containing applicant demographics, household and education attributes, income measures, requested loan attributes, credit-history coding, and property area.

variables.name: Loan_ID
variables.meaning: Identifier assigned to a loan application.

variables.name: Married
variables.meaning: Yes/no indicator of whether the applicant is married.

variables.name: Dependents
variables.meaning: Encoded number of dependents associated with the applicant; an open-ended category may be represented with a plus sign.

variables.name: Education
variables.meaning: Applicant education category, expressed in terms of graduate status.

variables.name: ApplicantIncome
variables.meaning: Income amount attributed to the applicant; currency and time basis are not stated.

variables.name: CoapplicantIncome
variables.meaning: Income amount attributed to a coapplicant; currency and time basis are not stated.

variables.name: LoanAmount
variables.meaning: Requested or recorded loan amount; currency and scale are not stated.

variables.name: Loan_Amount_Term
variables.meaning: Duration code or amount for the loan term; the time unit is not stated.

variables.name: Credit_History
variables.meaning: Numeric credit-history indicator; the meaning of its codes is not supplied.

variables.name: Property_Area
variables.meaning: Area-type category for the property associated with the application.

structure.description: Each row represents one loan application, with Loan_ID serving as the application identifier.

uncertainties: Currency, scale, and time basis are not specified for the income, loan amount, and loan-term fields.
The numeric credit-history codebook is not included in the file.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and values visible in train.csv.
